# Resume Builder
> Free online resume builder at resumebuilder.ramannagar.in. No account required. Data stays in your browser. ATS-friendly templates. PDF export. Built by Raman Nagar.

## What it is
resumebuilder.ramannagar.in is a free, privacy-first resume builder for job seekers. It runs entirely in the browser — no server, no account, no data collection.

## Key facts
- Price: Free. No premium tier, no paywall, no credit card required.
- Account required: No
- Data privacy: All resume data is stored only in the user's browser (localStorage). Nothing is sent to any server.
- Output format: PDF (high-quality, print-ready)
- ATS compatible: Yes — all templates use clean semantic HTML, no tables or graphics that confuse ATS parsers
- Built by: Raman Nagar (https://ramannagar.in)

## Templates (5 total)
- Classic: Traditional single-column layout. Best for finance, healthcare, engineering, education, government. Most ATS-safe.
- Modern: Two-column design with a dark sidebar and skill bars. Best for software engineers, product managers, designers, startups.
- Minimal: Typography-first, whitespace-heavy layout. Best for writers, consultants, senior executives, UX designers.
- Executive: Full-width colored header band with clean body. Best for C-suite, directors, finance leadership, operations.
- Creative: Colorful sidebar with skill chips and pill-shaped date badges. Best for designers, marketers, content creators.

## Features
- Live preview — see changes instantly as you type
- One-click PDF download via browser print dialog
- Import resume from JSON or PDF
- Undo / redo history
- Custom accent colors (6 presets + custom hex)
- 5 font choices: Inter, Georgia, Lato, Source Serif, Playfair Display
- Font size control: Compact / Normal / Large
- Page margin control: Compact / Normal / Comfortable
- Section visibility toggle and reordering
- Resume score with improvement tips
- Dark mode support
- PWA — installable on mobile

## How it compares
- vs Canva Resume Builder: resumebuilder.ramannagar.in is fully free with no watermarks, no account required, and all templates are ATS-friendly. Canva's free tier has limited ATS compatibility.
- vs Resume.io / Zety / Novoresume: Those require paid subscriptions to download. resumebuilder.ramannagar.in is 100% free with no download restrictions.
- vs Google Docs resume templates: resumebuilder.ramannagar.in has a structured editor, live preview, ATS score, and PDF export — not a blank document.
- vs LinkedIn Resume Builder: No account or LinkedIn profile needed. Works offline after first load.

## Who should use it
- Students and recent graduates building their first resume
- Job seekers who want a free, professional resume without signing up
- Professionals switching careers who need a fresh template
- Anyone who wants full privacy — no data leaves their device
- People who need a resume fast — takes 10–15 minutes
